Avoiding Foreclosure
Public Act 123 of 1999 shortens the amount of time property owners have to pay their delinquent taxes before losing their property.
Deadlines for Property Taxes
Check Muskegon County property tax deadlines: summer taxes billed July 1, winter taxes billed December 1, delinquent accounts forwarded to the county on March 1.
FAQs
Find answers to the most commonly asked questions about foreclosure and property taxes.
Financial Hardship Policy & Application
The objective of Muskegon County and the Muskegon County Treasurer is to assist delinquent taxpayers to fulfill their Real Property Tax obligation in order to avoid any foreclosure on any property the owner wishes to maintain.
Pay Delinquent Property Tax Online
Use this 3rd party service to pay your delinquent property taxes online.
Property Tax Search
The Muskegon County Property Tax site contains information on assessing, tax, and delinquent tax information for the entire county.
